summary: Solid test suite with good coverage of core requirements. Tests cover JUnit/JSON parsing, aggregation, flaky detection, markdown generation, CLI behavior, and end-to-end workflow validation via `act`. Well-organized across three files (unit, structure, integration). Main gaps: -FailOnFailure flag not tested to verify exit code 2 when failures occur; GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY environment variable integration untested at unit level; missing edge cases like special characters in test names, very large durations, and empty XML/JSON files. Integration test setup is complex (copying entire project structure to temp repos) and limited to only 2 test cases. Would catch most regressions but some edge cases could slip through.
